basics.name: Omar Boza
basics.label: Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer | Tech Lead | React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, PostgreSQL
basics.summary: Senior frontend-focused full-stack developer and Tech Lead teams escalate to for feasibility calls, root-cause debugging, and hard delivery. Strong hands-on React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; solid PostgreSQL/SQL and REST APIs; deploys on Vercel. Built AIDA, a production dental clinic SaaS. Made the call that seat-level booking could ship inside WordPress; recovered a year-delayed web + mobile product in 3 months; was the WordPress and front-end reference at Your Digital Resource. Ships faster with responsible AI-assisted development (Cursor, Claude Code). Fluent in English (EF SET C2) and Spanish. Based in Managua, Nicaragua; remote-ready.

work.name: Your Digital Resource
work.summary: Team escalation point for WordPress and front-end; production web delivery, performance optimization, and AI-assisted development workflows for US clients.
highlights: Was the team's reference for WordPress and front-end: unusual WordPress behavior, multi-layer cache issues that hid shipped changes, and Webflow/CSS blockers got escalated to me; onboarded new developers and coached the team through technical stuck points.
Diagnosed and fixed multi-layer cache issues that made correct deployments look like failed changes, then optimized the layers so the problem stopped recurring.
Built AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, n8n) that cut repetitive UI/content edits from days to hours and performance optimization from 90 to 20 minutes (GTmetrix Grade F to A).
Debugged and optimized Core Web Vitals and page-load issues across multiple concurrent client projects in a fast-moving remote team.
Used Playwright from the command line, with AI-assisted workflows, to run and iterate automated UI checks.

work.name: Nicasource
work.summary: Full-stack web development for international clients using React, Vue, and modern JavaScript; feasibility calls on complex requirements.
highlights: Made the feasibility call that a client seat-reservation system could ship inside WordPress — modeling seats, availability, and bookings with custom post types and meta — instead of a separate application the team would have to sync forever.
Owned delivery of client web applications using React and Vue, including reusable UI components and responsive layouts.
Contributed to frontend architecture, component design, and application performance across concurrent international projects.

work.name: Top Floor Marketing
highlights: Built automation workflows that increased lead volume across client portfolio sites by 30%.
Optimized Core Web Vitals and on-page performance for production marketing sites.

work.name: AIM Services
highlights: As Tech Lead, recovered a year-delayed web + mobile application: web and mobile had drifted onto duplicated, out-of-sync logic; put both sides back on one source of truth, cleared the backlog, and shipped to production in 3 months.
Owned architecture and delivery for a dual web/mobile application built with Ionic and modern JavaScript.

work.name: Target Ogilvy
highlights: Introduced Laravel into plain-PHP projects, expanding maintainable backend/API capabilities for agency clients.
Developed real-time web systems for live events and campaigns, where failures were visible to audiences in the moment.

projects.name: AIDA
projects.description: Production HealthTech SaaS for dental clinics, requested by a practicing dentist. Built end-to-end: patients, odontograms, appointments, clinical records, and payments. Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL/SQL; REST APIs; deployed on Vercel with a self-managed Insforge (PostgreSQL) backend. Implemented role-based access control so clinical data is visible only to authorized physicians; designed around least-privilege and healthcare data privacy principles (HIPAA-conscious practices—not a formal certification claim).
